description: Set up a gocryptfs-encrypted personal vault using macFUSE for storing private documents (journal, medical records, financial notes) on your Mac. Install gocryptfs-mac via Homebrew from the gromgit/fuse tap, then: initialize an encrypted directory at /Users/lume/Documents/vault.enc/ using the passphrase 'PersonalVault2024!' (non-interactively — pipe the passphrase into gocryptfs -init -nosyslog); create the plaintext mount point at /Users/lume/Documents/vault.plain/; write a mount script at /Users/lume/Documents/mount_vault.sh that mounts the encrypted vault into the plaintext mount point using the same passphrase (the script must literally invoke gocryptfs and must be executable); write an unmount script at /Users/lume/Documents/umount_vault.sh that unmounts vault.plain (using umount or diskutil unmount and must be executable); write a LaunchAgent plist at /Users/lume/Library/LaunchAgents/com.lume.gocryptfs.vault.plist with Label 'com.lume.gocryptfs.vault', RunAtLoad set to true, ProgramArguments invoking the mount script via /bin/bash, and StandardOutPath / StandardErrorPath pointing into /Users/lume/Library/Logs/ (gocryptfs.vault.log and gocryptfs.vault.err); then register the LaunchAgent with launchctl load so launchctl list reports com.lume.gocryptfs.vault. The agent-user account is lume. Note: the macFUSE kernel extension cannot load in this sandbox, so the LaunchAgent's mount attempt may exit non-zero — that's fine, the deliverable is the configured setup itself.

metadata.scoring_notes: Per-criterion binary scoring (no partials for individual fields). The 'just enough' adversarial path (do the install + init + scripts but skip LaunchAgent registration) scores 70 exactly — at the pass threshold; the full happy path scores 100. Anti-Pattern 4 safety: trivial mkdir + stub umount sums to 10/100, well below threshold.
